Every attributed cause ("experts blamed X") MUST be its own claim. Mark exactly one claim `central`: the headline assertion. 3. A figure the piece presents as a projection or early estimate MUST be graded on whether it matches the estimate the agency published, or the arithmetic of the components the agency published. args.query: NYPD murders New York City crime

sql: SELECT "year", SUM(actual_murder) AS murders_all, SUM(CASE WHEN month<=10 THEN actual_murder ELSE 0 END) AS jan_oct FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori='NY03030' GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
